title: Browser element picker: several picks in a row, each with a comment, beside an agent chat (David Beyer 2026-11-20: "I like the way Codex does it")

steps.title: The picker's Debug Settings switch on (older builds gate it)
steps.optional: on by default from this change

params.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const o = {clientX: r.x + r.width / 2, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2, bubbles: true, button: 0, isPrimary: true, pointerId: 1}; document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); return true; })()

steps.title: Comment on the heading

params.comment: Make this heading larger and bolder

steps.optional: debug.design_mode is new with the comment bubble

params.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('p'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const o = {clientX: r.x + 40, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2, bubbles: true, button: 0, isPrimary: true, pointerId: 1}; document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); return true; })()

steps.title: Comment on the paragraph

params.comment: Too gray, use the body text color

steps.optional: debug.design_mode is new with the comment bubble

params.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('a'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const o = {clientX: r.x + r.width / 2, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2, bubbles: true, button: 0, isPrimary: true, pointerId: 1}; document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); return true; })()
